text.p: These are the leading stories in the Lebanese press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Constitutional Council cancelled membership of four of its members.
- Lebanese journalists will hold a sit-in on Tuesday in solidarity with Jordanian journalists.
- Prime Minister Hariri said: "We did not bet on peace and we will go on in our reconstruction programmes".
- 310 Arab investor and businessmen participate in Arab financial conference in Beirut.
- A bomb explosion wounded an Israeli soldier in south Lebanon.
- Three Constitutional Council members will be nominated by the parliament today.
- Teachers at state-owned schools will go on one-day strike to demand retirement payment scale.
- Pope's visit to Lebanon, 12 days ago, will have positive reflection on the Lebanese situation, U.S. ambassador to Lebanon Richard Jones said.
- Parliament speaker Berri criticised the decisions of the Constitutional Council related to accepting four appeals by defeated candidates in election last year.
